_note: UI copy for the auto-generated plan pages and catalogs (site/planes/p/, site/en/plans/p/, site/pt/planos/p/, and the three catalog index pages). Written natively per language, not machine-translated — SPANISH IS TUTEO as of September 4, 2026 (Iván's call) — ~~matches the vos/voseo register the rest of the site already uses~~; the whole ES marketing surface was converted that day and now complies with brand-guidelines.md §8, which had specified tú since the start and was simply not being followed (not the tu form brand-guidelines.md nominally calls for; ~~the live site is consistently vos in Spanish, this follows it~~ — FALSE as of September 5, 2026: the sweep finished and no Spanish surface is voseo any more; the blog is the only remainder and it is tracked in open-loops.md). Distance/focus values from the inventory (Sprint, Olympic, HYROX, Base, FTP...) are shown as-is in every language — they're used as loanwords in ES/PT endurance-sport content and a clean per-value translation table isn't worth building for Phase 1.

es.breakdownTitle: Qué vas a entrenar por semana
es.breakdownIntro: Datos reales del plan en TrainingPeaks: sesiones, duración promedio y la más larga de la semana.
es.noBreakdown: Todavía no tenemos el detalle semanal de este plan cargado — el plan en TrainingPeaks sí lo incluye completo.
es.ctaNote: Te lleva a TrainingPeaks para completar la compra de forma segura.
es.captureHeading: ¿No sabes si este plan es para ti?
es.captureBody: Déjanos tu email y te ayudamos a elegir el plan correcto para tu objetivo y tu fecha. Sin costo, y no hace falta para comprar.
es.captureSuccess: Listo. Te escribimos dentro de las próximas 24 horas.
es.captureError: No se pudo enviar — puedes seguir con la compra igual.
es.allAccessHeading: ¿Por qué comprar un plan si puedes tenerlos todos?
es.allAccessBody: Este plan solo, más TrainingPeaks Premium por separado, suma más que All-Access: todos los planes + Premium incluido, por un precio fijo mensual.
es.catalogIntro: Todos nuestros planes en TrainingPeaks, filtrados por deporte, distancia, nivel y duración.
es.noResults: No hay planes con esos filtros. Prueba con menos filtros.

forWhoLevel.Beginner: Estás empezando, o vuelves después de una pausa. El plan arranca desde una base accesible y progresa sin saltos.
forWhoLevel.Intermediate: Ya entrenas de forma regular y quieres estructura. El plan asume una base aeróbica formada.
forWhoLevel.Advanced: Tienes temporadas encima y buscas rendimiento. El volumen y la intensidad son exigentes desde el arranque.

es.forWhoTime: Puedes entrenar {sessions} días por semana, alrededor de {hours} en una semana promedio.
es.forWhoLongest: La sesión más larga del plan es de {longest}: necesitas un día con ese hueco disponible.
es.forWhoWeeks: Tienes {weeks} semanas por delante antes de tu objetivo. Si te quedan menos, elige un plan más corto.

forWhoMetric.pace: Entrenas por ritmo, con un reloj GPS.
forWhoMetric.hr: Entrenas por frecuencia cardíaca, con banda o reloj con sensor óptico.
forWhoMetric.power: Entrenas por potencia, con potenciómetro o rodillo inteligente.

es.methodPolarized: Distribución polarizada 80/20: la mayor parte del volumen en intensidad baja y controlada, y una porción chica —pero bien ubicada— en intensidad alta. Es la misma metodología que usamos con los atletas de coaching 1-1.
es.methodProgression: La carga progresa por bloques, con semanas de descarga para asimilar el trabajo. No es una suma lineal de kilómetros.
es.methodZones: El plan trabaja por zonas. Si todavía no tienes las tuyas definidas, escríbenos y te ayudamos a calcularlas: el soporte por mail está incluido.
es.methodStrength: Incluye trabajo de fuerza integrado al calendario, no como un agregado suelto: las sesiones están ubicadas para no competir con las series clave.

gearMetric.pace: Un reloj GPS que registre ritmo.
gearMetric.hr: Banda de frecuencia cardíaca o reloj con sensor óptico.
gearMetric.power: Potenciómetro o rodillo inteligente que mida potencia.

gearSport.Triathlon: Acceso a piscina, bici o rodillo, y espacio para correr.
gearSport.Duathlon: Bici o rodillo, y espacio para correr.
gearSport.Running: Espacio para correr, en calle o cinta.

es.gearStrength: Acceso a gimnasio o equipamiento básico en casa, según la variante del plan.
es.gearTP: Una cuenta de TrainingPeaks (la versión gratuita alcanza para seguir el plan).
es.tpSync: Cada sesión se sincroniza con tu reloj o ciclocomputador —Garmin, Polar, Wahoo, Suunto y otros— como entrenamiento estructurado, con los intervalos y las zonas ya cargados.
es.tpApp: Sigues el plan desde la app de TrainingPeaks: la sesión del día, las notas de cada entrenamiento y el calendario completo.
es.tpStart: Eliges la fecha de inicio cuando lo aplicas y el calendario se acomoda solo.
es.tpReusable: El plan es reutilizable: lo aplicas de nuevo las veces que quieras, sin volver a pagar.
es.tpSupport: Soporte por mail ilimitado y sin costo. Si algo no cierra, escríbenos.
es.ctaHeading: Coaching 1:1 en vez de un plan autoguiado
es.ctaBody: Un plan te da la estructura. El coaching 1:1 suma testing personalizado, ajustes semana a semana y alguien mirando tus datos cuando algo no cierra. Cuéntanos tu objetivo y tu fecha.
es.helpBody: Cuéntanos tu objetivo, tu fecha de carrera y cuántos días por semana puedes entrenar. Te decimos qué plan te sirve — o si ninguno de estos es el indicado.
es.waText: Hola Iván, estoy viendo el plan "{plan}" y no sé si es el indicado para mí.

en.breakdownIntro: Real data from the plan on TrainingPeaks: sessions, average duration, and the longest session of the week.
en.noBreakdown: We don't have the weekly breakdown loaded for this plan yet — the full detail is there once you're on TrainingPeaks.
en.ctaNote: Takes you to TrainingPeaks to complete your purchase securely.
en.captureHeading: Not sure this plan is right for you?
en.captureBody: Leave your email and we'll help you pick the right plan for your goal and your date. Free, and not required to buy.
en.captureSuccess: Got it. We'll be in touch within 24 hours.
en.captureError: Couldn't send that — you can still go ahead and buy.
en.allAccessHeading: Why buy one plan when you can have them all?
en.allAccessBody: This plan alone, plus TrainingPeaks Premium separately, adds up to more than All-Access: every plan + Premium included, for one flat monthly price.
en.catalogIntro: Every plan we sell on TrainingPeaks, filterable by sport, distance, level and duration.
en.noResults: No plans match those filters. Try clearing one.

forWhoLevel.Beginner: You're starting out, or coming back after a break. The plan starts from an accessible base and progresses without jumps.
forWhoLevel.Intermediate: You already train regularly and want structure. The plan assumes an established aerobic base.
forWhoLevel.Advanced: You have seasons behind you and you're chasing performance. Volume and intensity are demanding from week one.

en.forWhoTime: You can train {sessions} days a week, around {hours} in an average week.
en.forWhoTimeNoHours: You can train {sessions} days a week.
en.forWhoLongest: The longest session in the plan is {longest} — you need one day with that much room in it.
en.forWhoWeeks: You have {weeks} weeks before your goal. If you have fewer, pick a shorter plan.

forWhoMetric.pace: You train by pace, with a GPS watch.
forWhoMetric.hr: You train by heart rate, with a strap or an optical-sensor watch.
forWhoMetric.power: You train by power, with a power meter or smart trainer.

en.methodPolarized: Polarized 80/20 distribution: most of the volume at low, controlled intensity, and a small — but well-placed — share at high intensity. The same methodology we use with our 1-1 coached athletes.
en.methodProgression: Load progresses in blocks, with recovery weeks to absorb the work. It isn't a linear pile-up of kilometres.
en.methodZones: The plan runs on training zones. If you haven't set yours yet, email us and we'll help you work them out — support is included.
en.methodStrength: Strength work is built into the calendar rather than bolted on: sessions are placed so they don't compete with the key workouts.

gearMetric.pace: A GPS watch that records pace.
gearMetric.hr: A heart-rate strap or a watch with an optical sensor.
gearMetric.power: A power meter or a smart trainer that measures power.

gearSport.Cycling: A road bike or an indoor trainer.
gearSport.Triathlon: Pool access, a bike or trainer, and somewhere to run.
gearSport.Duathlon: A bike or trainer, and somewhere to run.
gearSport.Running: Somewhere to run, road or treadmill.

en.gearStrength: Gym access or basic equipment at home, depending on the plan variant.
en.gearTP: A TrainingPeaks account (the free tier is enough to follow the plan).
en.tpSync: Every session syncs to your watch or head unit — Garmin, Polar, Wahoo, Suunto and others — as a structured workout, with the intervals and zones already loaded.
en.tpApp: You follow the plan from the TrainingPeaks app: today's session, the notes on each workout, and the full calendar.
en.tpStart: You pick the start date when you apply it, and the calendar arranges itself.
en.tpReusable: The plan is re-usable: apply it again as many times as you like, at no extra cost.
en.tpSupport: Unlimited email support, free. If something doesn't add up, write to us.
en.ctaHeading: 1:1 coaching rather than a self-guided plan
en.ctaBody: A plan gives you the structure. 1:1 coaching adds personalised testing, week-by-week adjustments and someone reading your data when something doesn't add up. Tell us your goal and your race date.
en.helpBody: Tell us your goal, your race date and how many days a week you can train. We'll tell you which plan fits — or if none of these is the right one.
en.waText: Hi Iván, I'm looking at the "{plan}" plan and I'm not sure it's the right one for me.

forWhoLevel.Beginner: Você está começando, ou voltando depois de uma pausa. O plano parte de uma base acessível e progride sem saltos.
forWhoLevel.Intermediate: Você já treina com regularidade e quer estrutura. O plano pressupõe uma base aeróbica formada.
forWhoLevel.Advanced: Você tem temporadas na bagagem e busca desempenho. O volume e a intensidade são exigentes desde o início.

pt.forWhoTime: Você pode treinar {sessions} dias por semana, cerca de {hours} numa semana média.

pt.forWhoLongest: A sessão mais longa do plano é de {longest}: você precisa de um dia com esse espaço livre.

gearMetric.pace: Um relógio GPS que registre ritmo.
gearMetric.hr: Cinta de frequência cardíaca ou relógio com sensor óptico.
gearMetric.power: Medidor de potência ou rolo inteligente que meça potência.

gearSport.Triathlon: Acesso a piscina, bicicleta ou rolo, e espaço para correr.
gearSport.Duathlon: Bicicleta ou rolo, e espaço para correr.
gearSport.Running: Espaço para correr, na rua ou na esteira.

pt.gearTP: Uma conta TrainingPeaks (a versão gratuita basta para seguir o plano).

pt.tpSupport: Suporte por e-mail ilimitado e gratuito. Se algo não fechar, escreva para a gente.
pt.ctaHeading: Coaching 1:1 em vez de um plano autoguiado
pt.ctaBody: O plano dá a estrutura. O coaching 1:1 acrescenta testes personalizados, ajustes semana a semana e alguém lendo os seus dados quando algo não fecha. Conte o seu objetivo e a data da prova.
pt.helpBody: Conte o seu objetivo, a data da prova e quantos dias por semana você consegue treinar. Dizemos qual plano serve — ou se nenhum destes é o certo.
